sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Bavara.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴瓦拉。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: In ways big and small, the Republican-controlled Congress has begun rebelling against President Trump as never before.
sentences.zh: 共和党控制的国会正以各种大大小小的方式，开始前所未有地反抗特朗普总统。

sentences.en: On everything from the war in Iran to his plan to use taxpayer money to pay his allies.
sentences.zh: 从伊朗战争到他计划动用纳税人的钱来支付他的盟友，事无巨细。

sentences.en: Today, Congressional Editor Julie Davis on whether the uprising is a preview of a new dynamic in Washington or a temporary show of independence
sentences.zh: 今天，国会编辑朱莉·戴维斯将探讨这种起义是华盛顿新动态的预演，还是仅仅是一场暂时的独立表演，

sentences.en: that will vanish just as quickly as it arrived.
sentences.zh: 随后就会像出现时一样迅速消失。

sentences.en: It's Monday, June 8th.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月8日，星期一。

sentences.en: Julie, it's wonderful to see you.
sentences.zh: 朱莉，很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: Great to see you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Thank you for coming on the show.
sentences.zh: 感谢你来到节目中。

sentences.en: I appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我很感激。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: I would say, Julie, I don't think you're going to contest this, that from the first moment of Trump's second term, the question on kind of everyone's mind
sentences.zh: 朱莉，我想你不会反驳这一点，那就是从特朗普第二个任期的第一刻起，每个人心中都在想的问题，

sentences.en: was whether the manner in which the president had consolidated his power had basically rendered this Congress, this Republican Congress, irrelevant, right?
sentences.zh: 就是总统巩固权力的方式是否已经让国会，这个共和党控制的国会，变得无关紧要了，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, it very much looked like a co-equal branch of government was choosing subservience very willingly.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，看起来政府中一个平等的部门非常自愿地选择了顺从。

sentences.en: And we started to ask the question, is Congress over?
sentences.zh: 我们开始问这个问题：国会终结了吗？

sentences.en: And the answer over the past 10 days or so seemed to change.
sentences.zh: 而在过去10天左右的时间里，答案似乎发生了变化。

sentences.en: And now it feels more like a no, it's not over.
sentences.zh: 现在感觉更像是：不，它没有终结。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I think in the first months of President Trump's second term, we were actually surprised on the Hill to see the degree to which Republicans were
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，我认为在特朗普总统第二个任期的头几个月里，我们在国会山实际上很惊讶地看到共和党人，

sentences.en: just deferring to him on everything, not just refusing to challenge him on things, but actively kind of giving back their power on some pretty key things, on spending,
sentences.zh: 在所有事情上都对他唯命是从，不仅拒绝在某些事情上挑战他，而且在一些非常关键的问题上，比如支出、

sentences.en: on trade and tariffs, on foreign policy, things that you typically see Congress jealously guarding as its own prerogatives, finding every possible way
sentences.zh: 贸易和关税、外交政策等方面，主动放弃了自己的权力，而这些通常是国会极力捍卫的特权，他们却想尽一切办法，

sentences.en: to give it over to the White House, and really even just avoiding voting on things altogether.
sentences.zh: 把权力交给白宫，甚至完全避免对某些事情进行投票。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It was literally like a kid in the playground saying, take this toy, take this toy, take this shovel, take this truck.
sentences.zh: 这简直就像操场上的孩子说：拿走这个玩具，拿走那个玩具，拿走这把铲子，拿走这辆卡车。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That was really all we were seeing from Republicans when it came to President Trump.
sentences.zh: 当涉及到特朗普总统时，我们看到的确实就是这些。

sentences.en: But in the last few weeks, we have seen some pretty rare and unusual resistance coming from Republicans.
sentences.zh: 但在过去几周里，我们看到共和党人出现了一些非常罕见且不寻常的抵制。

sentences.en: They're refusing to act on legislation that's a big priority for him, refusing to move on the timelines that he's set out for them.
sentences.zh: 他们拒绝处理对他来说是重中之重的立法，拒绝按照他设定的时间表行事。

sentences.en: They're stripping things from legislation and forcing the administration to drop proposals that they don't like.
sentences.zh: 他们从立法中删除了某些内容，并迫使政府放弃他们不喜欢的提案。

sentences.en: And in the case of the war in Iran, they're actually using their power to push back on President Trump.
sentences.zh: 而在伊朗战争的问题上，他们实际上正在利用自己的权力来回击特朗普总统。

sentences.en: They're basically rebelling.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上是在反叛。

sentences.en: They're rebelling.
sentences.zh: 他们正在反叛。

sentences.en: To go back to your playground metaphor, Michael, it's a little bit like a group of kids who have obeyed their daddy for many, many months on pretty much everything.
sentences.zh: 回到你的操场比喻，迈克尔，这有点像一群孩子，他们在过去许多个月里对爸爸几乎言听计从。

sentences.en: And are finally just saying, no, daddy, we're not going to do this for you.
sentences.zh: 最后终于说：不，爸爸，我们不会为你做这件事。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: That's quite a vivid completion of the metaphor.
sentences.zh: 这个比喻完成得相当生动。

sentences.en: So take us behind the scenes
sentences.zh: 那么，带我们了解一下幕后情况，

sentences.en: of this rebellion, if that's what we're going to be calling it.
sentences.zh: 如果这就是我们要称呼它的那种反叛的话。

sentences.en: And we'll get to how durable it is and how far it may or may not go.
sentences.zh: 我们会谈到它能持续多久，以及它可能会走多远。

sentences.en: But let's just understand it to the extent that it has been unfolding.
sentences.zh: 但让我们先了解一下它展开的程度。

sentences.en: On the surface, a lot of it seemed to revolve around the weaponization fund, the president's nearly $2 billion effort to compensate people he claims
sentences.zh: 从表面上看，很多事情似乎都围绕着“武器化基金”展开，这是总统近20亿美元的计划，旨在补偿他声称的，

sentences.en: are victims of overzealous government prosecution.
sentences.zh: 那些受到过度热心的政府起诉的受害者。

sentences.en: But my sense is that that's not quite the full story.
sentences.zh: 但我的感觉是，这并不是全部真相。

sentences.en: Yeah, it actually started long before the Trump administration announced that they were creating that fund.
sentences.zh: 是的，实际上这在特朗普政府宣布设立该基金之前很久就开始了。

sentences.en: And this has been percolating for many weeks.
sentences.zh: 这已经酝酿了许多周。

sentences.en: And it's really, I think, a matter of Republicans sort of slowly and then very quickly waking up to the reality that a lot of what President Trump is doing
sentences.zh: 我认为，这实际上是共和党人慢慢地，然后非常迅速地意识到一个现实，即特朗普总统所做的很多事情，

sentences.en: is actually counter to their own political interests.
sentences.zh: 实际上违背了他们自己的政治利益。

sentences.en: Let's remember that we are just months away from the midterm elections and Trump is intervening in Republican primaries against some pretty popular members of their caucus
sentences.zh: 让我们记住，距离中期选举只有几个月了，而特朗普正在共和党初选中干预，针对他们党团中一些非常受欢迎的成员，

sentences.en: who are incumbents who are fighting for their political lives.
sentences.zh: 那些正在为自己的政治生命而战的现任议员。

sentences.en: He intervenes in Louisiana, endorses a Republican congresswoman who's running against Bill Cassidy, the senator who's the head of the health committee, who has spent years
sentences.zh: 他在路易斯安那州进行干预，支持了一位正在与比尔·卡西迪竞选的共和党女议员，卡西迪是参议院卫生委员会主席，他花了多年时间，

sentences.en: in trying to ingratiate himself with Trump after having voted to convict him at his impeachment trial after January 6th.
sentences.zh: 试图在1月6日弹劾审判中投票给特朗普定罪后，重新讨好他。

sentences.en: But Trump ultimately decided he wanted to take him out.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普最终决定他想除掉他。

sentences.en: And did.
sentences.zh: 而且他做到了。

sentences.en: And he did.
sentences.zh: 他做到了。

sentences.en: And he did.
sentences.zh: 他确实做到了。

sentences.en: But the second Senate primary where President Trump intervened, and I think the more stinging one that made Republicans a lot angrier, was in Texas.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普总统干预的第二个参议院初选，我认为更让共和党人愤怒的是在德克萨斯州。

sentences.en: Where Senator John Cornyn had been facing a challenge from Ken Paxton, the attorney general, they were in a runoff, it was going to be a competitive one,
sentences.zh: 参议员约翰·科宁面临总检察长肯·帕克斯顿的挑战，他们进入了决选，这将是一场竞争激烈的选举，

sentences.en: President Trump had stayed neutral, and days before, the primary, he weighs in and endorses Ken Paxton.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统此前保持中立，但在初选前几天，他介入并支持了肯·帕克斯顿。

sentences.en: And that news that the president was going to do that just hit Republicans on the Hill like a bomb.
sentences.zh: 总统要那样做的消息，对国会山的共和党人来说简直像一颗炸弹。

sentences.en: They were completely irate, in part because Cornyn was seen as the much stronger candidate who would be able to win that seat without having to spend a lot of money,
sentences.zh: 他们完全愤怒了，部分原因是科宁被视为更强大的候选人，他无需花费大量资金就能赢得那个席位，

sentences.en: without having to really worry about it, because there are obviously a lot of other seats that they need to be worrying about defending in the midterm year.
sentences.zh: 无需真正担心它，因为显然还有很多其他席位需要他们在中期选举年去捍卫。

sentences.en: So that just soured the mood among Republicans who are sort of looking around, seeing that President Trump's agenda is getting less and less popular with voters,
sentences.zh: 所以这破坏了共和党人的情绪，他们环顾四周，看到特朗普总统的议程在选民中越来越不受欢迎，

sentences.en: seeing that he's doing things really they feel like are for himself and not for the good of the party.
sentences.zh: 看到他所做的事情，他们觉得纯粹是为了他自己，而不是为了党的利益。

sentences.en: You know, Republicans are fighting to hold on to majorities in both chambers, and they have an uphill battle, and there started to be a real feeling
sentences.zh: 你知道，共和党人正在努力保住两院的多数席位，他们面临着一场艰苦的战斗，并且开始有一种真实的感觉，

sentences.en: like he was making it harder for them.
sentences.zh: 觉得他正在让事情变得更困难。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And I should say that both of these senators are very popular with their Republican colleagues.
sentences.zh: 我应该说，这两位参议员在他们的共和党同事中都非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: They're seen as effective, they're seen as experienced, and they know how to do their jobs.
sentences.zh: 他们被视为高效、经验丰富，并且知道如何做好自己的工作。

sentences.en: And the very same day that Trump came out and endorsed Paxton against Cornyn in the weekly party lunch.
sentences.zh: 就在特朗普出来支持帕克斯顿对抗科宁的同一天，在每周的党内午餐会上，

sentences.en: Bill Cassidy, returning for the first time since being defeated in his primary, got a standing ovation from Republicans.
sentences.zh: 比尔·卡西迪在初选失败后首次回归，得到了共和党人的起立鼓掌。

sentences.en: It was kind of like a moment where they sort of were saying, you're our guy, even if you're not President Trump's.
sentences.zh: 这就像是一个时刻，他们似乎在说：你是我们的人，即使你不是特朗普总统的人。

sentences.en: Clearly, what's starting to dawn on these Republicans is that Trump is making the midterms about him, making it about revenge, not at all what's best for a party
sentences.zh: 显然，这些共和党人开始意识到，特朗普正在把中期选举变成他自己的事，变成复仇的事，这根本不是一个试图保持国会控制权的政党所需要的。

sentences.en: trying to keep control of Congress.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，在这些共和党人眼中，特朗普显然正在做的事情，

sentences.en: And on top of all this, what Trump is clearly doing in the eyes of these Republicans
sentences.zh: 是奖励他们的顺从。

sentences.en: is rewarding their subservience.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，科宁投票支持特朗普的比例高达90%以上。

sentences.en: I mean, Cornyn votes with Trump
sentences.zh: 卡西迪也是如此。

sentences.en: 90-something percent of the time.
sentences.zh: 用惩罚他们并迫使他们离职来奖励这种顺从。

sentences.en: Same with Cassidy.
sentences.zh: 所以为什么要继续顺从，这基本上成了问题所在。

sentences.en: Rewarding that with them being punished and forced out of office.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So why should they keep being subservient starts to basically be the question.
sentences.zh: 这就是问题所在。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 而这就是背景，政府在没有事先通知国会山任何共和党人的情况下，宣布将成立这个反武器化基金，

sentences.en: That is the question.
sentences.zh: 金额为17.76亿美元，政府称是为了补偿那些被联邦政府迫害的人。

sentences.en: And this is the context in which the administration announces without any advanced word to any Republican on Capitol Hill that they will be forming this anti-weaponization fund
sentences.zh: 这清楚地暗示，这是为了那些忠于特朗普总统的人，包括可能包括1月6日冲击国会大厦的暴徒，他认为这些人被政府冤枉了，

sentences.en: of $1.776 billion to, the administration says, compensate people who have been victimized by the federal government.
sentences.zh: 并受到了不公正的针对。

sentences.en: A clear implication that this is for people loyal to President Trump, including potentially the mob that stormed the Capitol on January 6th, who he feels have been wronged
sentences.zh: 所以他想用联邦资金来支付这些人。

sentences.en: by the government and unfairly targeted.
sentences.zh: 而在共和党人对总统及其决策方式感到紧张的背景下，这简直让他们感到震惊。

sentences.en: And so he would like to use federal money to pay these people.
sentences.zh: 我的第一反应是，这根本说不通。

sentences.en: And this just sort of, in the context of all of this tension that Republicans are feeling toward the president and how he's making his decisions
sentences.zh: 这可能是一个你会发现很多两党质疑这是否是个好主意的问题领域。

sentences.en: just hits them like a ton of bricks.
sentences.zh: 这是他绕过国会以他认为合适的方式使用资金的又一个例子。

sentences.en: My first reaction was, this doesn't pass the smell teSt.
sentences.zh: 政府将不得不回答很多问题。

sentences.en: This might be one area where you might find a lot of bipartisan
sentences.zh: 这些人不值得赔偿。

sentences.en: questioning of whether or not this is a good idea.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人应该进监狱。

sentences.en: This is another instance of him going around Congress to use money in the way that he sees fit.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这简直是愚蠢透顶。

sentences.en: There are a lot of questions that the administration is going to have to answer.
sentences.zh: 别忘了，

sentences.en: These people don't deserve restitution.
sentences.zh: 共和党人在弹劾审判中努力让他无罪释放。

sentences.en: Many of them deserve to be in prison.
sentences.zh: 自1月6日以来，他们多年来一直忠于他。

sentences.en: I mean, this is just stupid on stilts.
sentences.zh: 但当人们袭击大厦时，他们都在1月6日的国会大厦里，他们都在逃命。

sentences.en: And let's not forget,
sentences.zh: 所以他们都在意识到这一点，无论是从个人层面还是坦率地说，从政治层面来看。

sentences.en: Republicans worked to acquit him at his impeachment trial.
sentences.zh: 他们将不得不在选民面前为这一点辩护，而此时他们中的许多人正在竞选连任。

sentences.en: They have been loyal to him for years since January 6th.
sentences.zh: 这看起来真的很糟糕，这不是他们想要支持的东西。

sentences.en: But they were all in the Capitol on January 6th when people assaulted the building and they were all running for their lives.
sentences.zh: 就好像有人起诉了自己，与自己达成了和解，而这笔钱将由我们其他人来买单。

sentences.en: So they're all, it's sort of dawning on them both personally and frankly, politically.
sentences.zh: 我可以告诉你，选民不喜欢这样。

sentences.en: They're going to have to defend this in front of voters at a time when they are, many of them are running for re-election.
sentences.zh: 或者如果他们喜欢，也许他们也是同谋。

sentences.en: This is really not a good look and this is not something that they want to have to stand behind.
sentences.zh: 这对他们来说不仅仅是一个学术练习，因为他们也意识到特朗普总统给他们设定了著名的最后期限之一，即6月1日，

sentences.en: It's as if somebody sued themselves, agreed upon a settlement with themselves, and that's going to be funded by the rest of us.
sentences.zh: 让他们通过他几个月来一直要求的700亿美元移民执法法案。

sentences.en: I can tell you, the voter doesn't like that.
sentences.zh: 他们正试图推进该法案，但他们开始意识到，因为他们对这个基金有太多的担忧，而且共和党内部有如此多的情绪，

sentences.en: Or if they like it, maybe they're in on it.
sentences.zh: 试图做点什么来阻止这个想法，他们可能无法获得通过移民法案所需的票数，除非他们采取行动，

sentences.en: And this is not just an academic exercise for them because what they also realize is that President Trump has set them one of his famous deadlines, a June 1st deadline,
sentences.zh: 要么让特朗普总统在基金问题上反悔，要么真正积极地写一些立法来阻止他这样做。

sentences.en: for them to deliver him the huge $70 billion immigration enforcement bill that he's been asking for for months.
sentences.zh: 所以，在总统提出这个可能会给1月6日暴徒钱的“武器化基金”这种有毒想法的同时，他还在对这些参议院共和党人说，

sentences.en: And they are trying to move on to that bill and they start to realize because they have so many concerns about this fund and there's so much sentiment among Republicans
sentences.zh: 通过我想要的那个庞大的支出法案，尽管我让你们陷入了各种困境。

sentences.en: to try to do something to shut this idea down that they're probably not going to be able to get the votes to move forward with the immigration bill unless they do something
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: to either get President Trump to reverse himself on the fund or actually affirmatively write some legislation to block him from doing it.
sentences.zh: 共和党人最初试图找出是否有办法做到这一点。

sentences.en: So at the same time that the president is putting forth this toxic idea of a weaponization fund that might give money to January 6th rioters, he's saying
sentences.zh: 代理司法部长托德·布兰奇来到国会山，试图缓解他们对基金的担忧。

sentences.en: to these Senate Republicans, pass this gargantuan spending bill I want even though
